about: 2026-11-01 attires (data\revport\attires\ATTIRES.md): Sting's costume 1 of 4 -- Revenge's four: his Wolfpac black and red with the red face paint, the same in black and white with the Crow's white paint, the surfer's green tights, the Crow's black coat (WCW/nWo Revenge's costume 1). One player's Versus (qa_versus): his box on the Superstar Select, first a tour of the Type arrows round all his costumes (C-right x8, C-left, C-right; a shot each), then the Type arrows to costume 1 (0x010B Type 1) and A; the CPU's pick The Rock; the match (the CPU plays him after 20 s). Look at the select's model, the VS card and him in the ring: the attire and its colours as Revenge's (attires\sheet_sting.png), head / mask, skin tone, hands / fingers.

expect.name: the match: 0x010B (player 1) vs The Rock (CPU)
expect.check: mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 120 and s0_id == 0x010B and s0_pad == 1 and s1_id == 0x0001 and s1_pad == 0

expect.name: no model's matrices ever went bad
